question: β₂ of normal distribution is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **β2 of normal distribution is 3:**

 
 
• In statistics, β2 represents the kurtosis of a distribution. Kurtosis measures the "tailedness" of the probability distribution of a real-valued random variable.
 
• For a normal distribution, the kurtosis (β2) is exactly 3. This indicates that the normal distribution has a moderate tail compared to other distributions.
 
• Financial enterprises often use kurtosis to assess the risk of extreme returns. A higher kurtosis would imply a higher risk of extreme outcomes, impacting portfolio management and risk assessment strategies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **β2 is 2:**

 
 
• This is incorrect. A β2 value of 2 would indicate a distribution with less pronounced tails than a normal distribution, which is not characteristic of a normal distribution.
 
 
 
• **β2 is 0:**
 
 
• This is incorrect. A β2 value of 0 would indicate a very flat distribution with no tails, which is not representative of a normal distribution.
 
 
 
• **β2 is 1:**
 
 
• This is incorrect. A β2 value of 1 would indicate a distribution with very slight tails, again not characteristic of a normal distribution.
